title.zh: Securitize launches 1:1-backed tokenized stocks, starting with Apple, Nvidia, Strategy and more

current_state.zh: Securitize launched tokenized US stocks on Solana that are backed 1:1 by real shares, pass through dividends, and settle in USDC, beginning with Apple, Nvidia, Strategy and other names.
